title.en: An Act to Appropriate the Sum of three thousand Five Hundred Pesos for the Creation of Government Scholarships in the College of Veterinary Science of the Philippine University.

text.en:
Twenty-five Government scholarships for Filipinos are hereby created in the College of
Veterinary Science of the Philippine University, to be filled subject to rules prescribed by the Board of
Regents of said university: Provided, That there shall not be more than ten of these scholarships for the first
year of the said college.

The sum of three thousand five hundred pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the
Insular Treasury not other-vise appropriated, to carry out the provisions of this Act mentioned in the preceding
section during the first year.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the same shall take effect on its
passage, in accordance with section one of Act Numbered Nineteen hundred and forty-five of the Philippine
Legislature.
Enacted, February 3. 1911.
